ranking_interpretation: Positive-slope logistic calibration is monotonic within each fold. AP/ROC-AUC should remain unchanged except for numerical ties or clipped endpoints. Pooled AP can change because fold scales change.
threshold_interpretation: The 80% target is used only on training-only OOF scores. Actual held-out recall can be lower or higher. This is an academic scenario, without clinical validation.

threshold_metrics_pooled.threshold_scope: fixed per outer fold from training-only OOF scores
fixed per outer fold from training-only OOF scores

bootstrap_method: 95% percentile patient-cluster bootstrap, resampling patients within each outer fold. All images of a sampled patient stay together. Single-class draws in any fold are excluded from all metrics and comparisons. Intervals are conditional on these fitted models, selected recipes, fixed folds and observed fold memberships; no retraining or recipe reselection is performed. They omit training variability and prior pilot adaptivity. Calibration maps and thresholds are also held fixed.
development_caveat: Development OOF evidence after earlier architecture, augmentation and recipe pilots; fold 0 also has archived exploratory results. Independent outer prediction within this run does not erase earlier adaptation to this development dataset. The locked test remains necessary after decisions are frozen.
metadata_comparison: Use the separate raw-reference matched metadata report; no comparator is selected using these calibrated outer results.
